title: Ambient equivariant ind-sheaves of the common-stage constructible heart
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. For each finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$, let $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and let $\mathcal C_X=\operatorname{Sh}_c(X,\Omega)$ be the actual common-stage constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Let $F_X$ be geometric Frobenius inverse image on this heart, restricted from the actual common-stage derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Use a size-equivalent small presentation $\mathcal C_X^s$ and its ordinary ind-category. Extend a heart functor $L$ to $\operatorname{Ind}(L)$ by left Kan extension of $L$ followed by Yoneda, along Yoneda. Its comparison on representables is the inverse of the Kan unit. Define
$$\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}=\operatorname{IsoAlg}(\operatorname{Ind}(F_X)).$$
These are all invertible Frobenius pairs in the ind-category of the underlying constructible heart; no finiteness condition is imposed on the Frobenius orbit. The category of constructible Weil sheaves is precisely the existing heart-carrier category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and its embedding in $\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ is induced by Yoneda and the inverse Kan unit. This embedding is fully faithful. The existing Weil heart is abelian, and $\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ is Grothendieck abelian.

For a morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ between finite-type $k_0$-schemes, define inverse image on these categories by restricting actual common-stage pullback to the heart and extending it to ind-objects. Normalize the pullback composition isomorphism on every rationalized integral representative by the integral composition comparison of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], with its specified finite reductions. The equality $\operatorname{Fr}_X\circ f=f\circ\operatorname{Fr}_Y$ and these normalized composition isomorphisms give $f^*F_Y\simeq F_Xf^*$. Restrict this square to hearts, transport it through the small presentation, and extend it to ind-objects by its specified Yoneda components. These characterizations uniquely determine all comparison arrows. The resulting functor $f^*:\mathcal W_Y^{\mathrm{amb}}\to\mathcal W_X^{\mathrm{amb}}$ has a right adjoint $f_*$. For an open immersion $j_0$ it also has a left adjoint $j_!$. The direct image is additive; the open left adjoint is the exact extension-by-zero operation. The adjunctions determine both operations and their Weil actions up to unique compatible isomorphism. No derived category of fixed pairs is substituted for the category of Weil complexes.

proof.text: Construct each common-stage component by rationalizing and including the prescribed integral compositor, conjugated by the pullback object equalities. Naturality of those explicit components is [lem-zl-common-stage-pullback-comp-naturality]. Assemble them with NatIso.ofComponents. Equality transports show the prescribed integral normalization. Every pair is literally a rationalized integral representative, so cancellation of its pullback comparison factors proves uniqueness.

Restrict the known t-exact pullback to the full standard heart; the fully faithful heart inclusion transports finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation. Frobenius is an isomorphism of schemes. Use isomorphismFieldTransport and t-exactness of its inverse to prove essential surjectivity on the heart as well as full faithfulness. Transport this equivalence through AsSmall.

The Ind inclusion is the left Kan extension of Yoneda along ind-Yoneda, using each ind-object's tautological filtered presentation. Identify Ind(F) followed by inclusion with presheaf left Kan extension along F.op. This proves preservation of filtered colimits and, for left-exact F, finite limits. Presheaf restriction and finite-limit preservation construct the right adjoint when F preserves finite colimits. A small-category adjunction induces the corresponding Ind adjunction by the two presheaf Kan adjunctions. If F is an equivalence, its Ind extension is one as well.

Both composites in the normalized Ind square are left Kan extensions along Yoneda. The unique comparison induced by the small Frobenius square gives the stated Yoneda components. Uniqueness follows from the Kan-extension hom-ext principle.

The Weil heart is equivalent to the IsoAlgebra category of the small underlying heart via the explicit fully faithful, essentially surjective carrier model. Transport its abelian structure. The Ind Frobenius equivalence is additive and preserves finite limits and colimits; fixed-pair abelianity and Grothendieck abelianity follow from the existing IsoAlgebra API.

The underlying exact heart inverse image extends to an exact Ind functor. Its normalized Frobenius square has an invertible mate since both Frobenius functors are equivalences. Lift the underlying right adjunction to fixed pairs using IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIsoAdjunction. Finite limits and colimits in fixed pairs are computed on carriers, yielding exactness of inverse image.

Use exact extension by zero on the common-stage heart, without a separatedness hypothesis on the finite-type schemes. Transport its adjunction to the small categories and to Ind. The inverse mate of the normalized Frobenius square is invertible and lifts this left adjunction to fixed pairs. Its left functor is exact on carriers; uniqueness of left adjoints transfers exactness to the specified open shriek.

proof_origin.place: First paragraph; C1 constructs normalized composition components directly, assembles them using their naturality, checks the integral normalization and proves uniqueness. The existing categorical Kan-extension and inverse-mate proofs are retained.
